task_description: The live storefront shows 0 products because data/products/brown-sofa.json (the verified 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set', id p_322e7n6mth, sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0, slug brown-sofa, price 41990) is committed as status DRAFT with no images, so getCatalogue()'s public-status filter excludes it from every prerendered surface. The admin 'Published' state and the 4 uploaded images lived only in local git-ignored KV/R2 and were never persisted to the committed JSON on GitHub, which is what Netlify/Cloudflare build from. Fix: persist the published state into the committed JSON by adding the 4 real image records recovered from local R2 (with alt text), setting status PUBLISHED + published true, keeping every verified identity/content field unchanged; rewrite the regression test that pinned the draft state to guard the published state instead; verify build + local storefront; and produce a script to upload the R2 originals to production. Then commit and push. Live Netlify verification is expected to require the user (external, unverifiable from here).

verification.summary: validate:content => 15 files valid. npx vitest run tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts => 15/15 pass (rewritten to guard the PUBLISHED state: status PUBLISHED, published true, 4 images, isCatalogueProduct true, checkPublishGate ok, primaryImage img_tchmzkuoeb, per-image non-empty alt + R2 key regex; corner-sofa still an image-less DRAFT; WhatsApp message still ends '(SKU: NGF-SOF-WBJZX0).'). npm test full suite (FEAT-002) => 966/972; the only failures are the 5 pre-existing FEAT-001 baseline failures (analytics.snapshot trigger regex, security.build-output x2 stale-artifact, seo.meta Windows path-sep, supporting-pages-showroom CRLF) plus one confirmed pre-existing auth.session.integration timing flake that passes in isolation (19/19); zero new catalogue-related failures. npm run build => SUCCESS through all 7 postbuild audits (now 25 pages vs 24 on the empty-catalogue base), including audit-image-loading and keyword-density. Independently re-verified the built storefront: dist/client/product/brown-sofa/index.html exists and contains 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set'; dist/client/collection/index.html lists it; the product enquiry CTA carries a wa.me link whose text single-decodes to "Hi New Galaxy Furniture, I'm interested in the Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set (SKU: NGF-SOF-WBJZX0).\nI would like to enquire about the price, availability and order details." for both configured numbers. No duplicate: SKU NGF-SOF-WBJZX0 / id p_322e7n6mth / slug brown-sofa each resolve to exactly one file (brown-sofa.json); no premium-3-1-1-sofa-set.json. test_quality: the regression test reads the committed brown-sofa.json and asserts the exact published state + identity + WhatsApp message, so it would fail if the publish were reverted or the SKU/name changed — a meaningful anchor. IN-SCOPE DEVIATION (coder, documented): gallery image alt text dropped the redundant 'by New Galaxy Furniture' brand suffix because it tripped the build-gating keyword-density audit on 3 pages (confirmed not pre-existing); alt remains non-empty/descriptive and the publish gate still passes.
